fusions.name: Reaping Dive
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. Swoops in a curved line for 20 damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Gleaning Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a curve around you, dealing 6 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gleaned Bounty
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Second Cut
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
